english.title: Cause the deposit from a motor vehicle of controlled waste in / on land without a permit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowingly caused controlled waste, namely **(..SPECIFY THE WASTE..), to be deposited from a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in or on land namely **(..SPECIFY THE LAND..),

(A)_[without the authority of]_
(B)_[other than in accordance with conditions contained within]_

a current environmental permit issued under the Environmental Protection Act 1990
english.legislation: Contrary to section 33(1)(a), (5), (6) and (8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) Where controlled waste is carried in and deposited from a motor vehicle, the person who controls or is in a position to control the use of the vehicle shall be treated as knowingly causing the waste to be deposited whether or not he gave any instructions for this to be done.
(ii) From 9th May 2016, this offence may be dealt with by way of a fixed penalty ticket under section 33ZA of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Either Way
Summary: maximum 6 / 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months for offences committed before 2nd May 2022; for offences committed on or after that date it may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 33(8) of the Environmental Protection Act 1990 and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Important Note
From 9th May 2016, this offence may be dealt with by way of a fixed penalty ticket under section 33ZA of the Environmental Protection Act 1990.
